title: Operator removals of a receipted head settle as a retryable Rejected that keeps the prompt's retry entry
outcome: Operator removals of a receipted head settle as a retryable Rejected that keeps the prompt's retry entry
acceptance: A removal that is an operator decision (cancel_queued_prompt, clear_queued_prompts_by_source*, retired promotion, child detach), settled through settle_removed_handing_off_head (src/prompt_delivery.rs), drops the retry entry or carries a distinct cause on the receipt, so requeue_rejected_prompt_delivery refuses it and a producer cannot re-queue a prompt the user cancelled; a transport rejection stays re-queueable.
a_removed_head_promoted_for_its_hand_off_is_rejected_durably_and_never_sent (src/tests/prompt_delivery.rs) asserts the removal is not re-queueable.
